scope: Read-only official API documentation check for the existing Futu data-intake path; no Futu OpenD call, vendor contact, order, subscription or purchase.
target: Frozen SOXX 2018-2022 decision-time 25-delta put-minus-call 30-calendar-day implied-volatility skew, requiring the contemporaneous chain, bid/ask, signed Delta, IV, underlying and first-availability/revision clocks.

official_sources.finding: get_option_chain returns static current-chain information and explicitly does not support querying expired option chains. Dynamic quotes require a separate subscription.

request_history_kline documents option candlesticks and daily history, but its listed K-line fields are OHLC/volume and related price fields, not a historical option-chain cross-section with contemporaneous bid/ask, IV and Delta. Intraday K-lines are limited to the last eight years and historical requests consume account quota.

Cboe's separate Option Sentiment specification lists norm_25d_skew_30, a normalized metric; it is not definitionally identical to the frozen raw 25-delta put-minus-call mid-IV formula without a separate mapping.
Cboe lists Option Sentiment historical availability from January 2012, which is a product-level start date, not proof of SOXX-specific daily coverage or entitlement.

decision: Futu's documented APIs do not establish a self-contained 2018-2022 SOXX historical skew source. Even if individual expired contract OHLC can be retrieved by independently known codes, that does not by itself reconstruct the required contemporaneous chain, quotes, IV/Delta and first-public vintages. Do not infer that the full source is impossible; no contract-code or entitlement probe was made.
next_action: Keep the existing ORATS/Cboe sample path on hold under the user's no-contact decision. Continue non-option Stage1 source qualification and failure-to-feature work; any later option-data purchase or vendor inquiry needs a new user instruction.
